name: Joou-sama no Josou Maid
source:
Female CEO and Queen Lisa’s Collection: A Slippery Weekend with Her Favorite Cross-Dressing Maids…
Whips, candles, maid-on-maid action, enemas, anal sex—anything goes, depending on the Queen’s mood.
translation:
女總裁兼女王莉莎的收藏：和她最愛的女裝男僕們共度一個濕滑的週末……
鞭子、蠟燭、女僕之間互相親熱、灌腸、肛交——只要女王有興致，什麼都能玩。
